name: shell-commands
title: Shell Commands
description: Store and manage frequently used terminal commands
author: brpaz

commands.name: list-command
commands.title: Commands
commands.description: List and manage your shell commands

commands.name: import-command
commands.title: Import Commands
commands.description: Import shell commands from a JSON file

commands.name: import-history-command
commands.title: Import from Shell History
commands.description: Pick frequently used commands from your bash, zsh or fish history

preferences.name: historyFile
preferences.title: History File
preferences.description: Shell history file to read. Leave empty to detect ~/.zsh_history, ~/.bash_history and fish history automatically.

commands.name: export-command
commands.title: Export Commands
commands.description: Export shell commands to a JSON file

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal Command
preferences.description: Terminal used by Run in Terminal, with any arguments needed to execute a command, e.g. 'kitty', 'alacritty -e' or 'gnome-terminal --'.

preferences.name: workingDirectory
preferences.title: Working Directory
preferences.description: Directory where shell commands behind {{name=$(command)}} placeholders run, unless the command has a {{cwd=@directory}} variable. Defaults to your home directory.
